svg.title: Hawkeye deep broad and shallow residual V-bit sweeps
svg.desc: Gray is approved thresholded black artwork. Blue is the broad V-bit sweep at 1.625 mm. Amber is shallow engraving of residual approved art at 0.04 mm. Red marks the hanger keepout; interface depth is unknown.

g.text: Blue: broad fill Z −1.625, width 0.971 mm • Amber: detail Z −0.04, width 0.121 mm
Broad passes: 0.6, 1.2, 1.625 mm • 0.27 mm broad stepover
110 × 110 stock • 100 mm circle centered at X55 Y55 • XY origin lower-left
Fine lines remain shallow with the V geometry. 3.25 mm nominal thickness; ply boundary unknown.
